description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 or 1.60 each), grants [Awoken Darkwood], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Holy, Dark)] and [Emptiness Break] to the user

description.name: Awoken Darkwood
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: Emptiness Break
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using a Dark or Holy ability

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack
